title: Interview with a Female Airline Pilot
transcript: Good morning and welcome to Career Focus. Today, we are speaking with Captain Linh, one of the youngest female commercial airline pilots in the region. Many people still believe that flying heavy aircraft is exclusively a career for men, but modern aviation relies on critical decision-making, technical discipline, and calm leadership rather than physical strength. In our airline, every pilot undergoes rigorous simulator assessments and emergency training regardless of their gender. When women are given equal educational opportunities and family support, they excel in complex technical environments. Captain Linh encourages young female high school students to pursue STEM subjects such as physics and computer science without fear of traditional stereotypes. Over the past decade, international aviation organisations have launched mentorship programs to recruit more women into aviation and engineering fields. Equal career opportunities not only empower individuals but also foster a diverse and innovative workforce for the nation's future development.
